name: Notable deep-space spacecraft (Horizons)
description: Retrieves 13 notable spacecraft from NASA/JPL Horizons VECTORS as Sun-centred ICRF trajectories in TDB. Coverage probes, paged daily samples and 10-minute departure and encounter windows are planned and parsed in C++/WASM. The host HTTP connector executes requests. Emits one size-prefixed OEM per craft on OEM.fbs, provider deep-space-spacecraft, source horizons, and evaluates its declared interpolation with the shared ephemeris evaluator.

sequentialJustification.detail: Bounded deterministic Horizons request planning, CSV parsing, OEM construction and interpolation over supplied frames. No host calls, threads or network access.
